Wear safety equipment as hard hat. shoes breathing mask safety glass ... etc

Close the main oil valve no 7

Set of common and special wrenches
Benzene kerosene and cleaning material (rag. cloth)
Garland with 8-10 lamps 36 v with cable 30 m
Metric hex key ( 10 mm) long arm

Open the hatches into spiral case & draft tube to organize the erection of 
 the illumination, entrance scaffold and required ladders

Carry out the inspection of the state of tunnel spiral case & draft tube 
 lining (by knock method)

Carry out the inspection of the state of turbine stator & the blades of 
 the guide vane apparatus
Carry out penetrant test on runner blades

Detecting corrosion the cavitation destruction welding break good order of 
 sealing rubber

Eliminate all the detected damages on runner guide vanes foundation ring 
 by means of welding over the cavitation damages with the next grinding cutting 
 defect welds

Dismantle rubber - holding stripes and change the damaged vertical rubber 
 sealing of guide vanes
Check up and replace the damaged end seal rubber
Cover with anticorrosion compound metal & on case hardening

Fill in the following formularies:
 - No 1 - of the butt gaps 
 of guide vane blades
 - No 2 - of the gapes on 
 the upper located labyrinth of the runner the gaps 
 between the 
 runner foundation ring
 - No 3 - of the 
 dependence of opening of guide vanes apparatus upon the 
 troke of servomotor rod.

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be performed every three 
years base as indicated by Y3 in the title block
The 
technical specification of the hydro unit: Francis turbine, maximum power:

Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued ad the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category
Wear safety equipment as hard hat. shoes breathing mask safety glass ... etc
Completely empty the tunnel
Water level in draft tube not exceed level of 100 m
Secure closing intake and draft tubes maintenance gates
Open the wicket gates to 100 %
Switch off F 403 automatic
Close the main oil valve no 7
Release pressure of the oil pressure unit (MHY) to zero
Using overhead crane 400 ton
Using lightening 36 V
Using 8 bar service air
Use suitable warning boards
